title: Fix JSON struct tag and unmarshal bugs in Go
description: A config struct has wrong JSON tags and the loader ignores unmarshal errors and reads the wrong field.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in config.go:
1. `Host` json tag: change `json:"hostname"` to `json:"host"`
2. `Load`: propagate the unmarshal error — `if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil { return nil, err }`
3. `Addr()`: return `fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", c.Host, c.Port)` (import `"fmt"`)
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
